entities.name: Lord Skitter
entities.description: Demonic rat king beneath Edgewall, empowered by fiendish blood.

entities.name: Totentanz
entities.description: Human minstrel who agreed to lure Edgewall's townsfolk for Skitter and was given a magic pipe.

entities.name: Edgewall
entities.description: Eldraine town above the ruins where Skitter lived.

events.summary: Totentanz met Lord Skitter, who promised him wicked powers in exchange for luring the townsfolk into the sewers.
events.quote: a human minstrel named Totentanz encountered Lord Skitter

events.summary: Skitter gifted Totentanz a magic pipe when he agreed to join him.
events.quote: Skitter gifted him a magic pipe.

events.summary: Totentanz led Edgewall citizens into the undercity and rats swarmed the city.
events.quote: Totentanz led droves of hapless Edgewall citizens into the undercity with his music.

events.summary: The townsfolk stole the pipe and turned its magic on Skitter and Totentanz, who were devoured by the rats.
events.quote: causing them to be devoured by their rat horde

relations.note: Agreed to join the rat king
relations.quote: When the bard agreed to join the rat king
